wbs.title: 1. Parametric Breakdown (WBS)
wbs.desc: Each feature is broken down into atomic technical tasks. AI assigns base hours based on historical benchmarks from similar projects (COCOMO II calibration data).

pert.title: 2. PERT Adjustment (Uncertainty)
pert.desc: PERT (Program Evaluation and Review Technique, PMI) applies three scenarios per task to mitigate software uncertainty.

formulas.title: 3. Duration & Cost Formulas
formulas.totalEffortDesc: Sum of E(PERT) for all tasks

assumptions.title: 5. Model Assumptions & Constraints
items: Effective capacity: 30h/week per FTE (excludes meetings, overhead)
Standard working month: 160h (160h = 4 weeks × 5 days × 8h)
Average weeks per month: 4.33 (ISO standard)
Contingency reserve: 10% of base cost (known risks, PMBOK)
Management reserve: 5% of base cost (unknown risks)
Brooks efficiency exponent: 0.8 (diminishing returns when adding people)
Minimum guaranteed duration: 50% of original plan regardless of headcount
Rates in USD/hour. Adjust for local market as needed.
PERT estimates assume 30% overhead for integration and testing
Schedule excludes post-launch phases from main duration calculation

agileMethodology.engineDesc: How sprints, velocity and costs are calculated for this project

sprintSizing.title: 1. Sprint Sizing (from WBS)
sprintSizing.desc: The AI distributes WBS tasks into 2-week windows. Each task is assigned to the sprint based on its calculated start week derived from its corresponding phase.

velocity.title: 2. Team Velocity Calculation
velocity.desc: Velocity represents the real team capacity per sprint. A 70% efficiency factor is applied to discount meetings, code reviews, and operational overhead.

assumptions.title: 4. Agile Model Assumptions
items: 2-week sprints (Scrum Guide 2020 standard duration)
Effective team efficiency: 70% (excludes ceremonies, blockers, overhead)
Individual capacity: 40 working hours/week per FTE
Actual velocity may vary ±15% depending on team maturity
WBS tasks distributed proportionally within each phase
Cost calculated on monthly burn rate (Rate × 160h × FTE)
Applied reserves: 10% contingency + 5% management (PMI standard)
Sprint Goal = name of the dominant phase in that time window
Utilization >90% indicates an overloaded sprint — rebalancing recommended
In Phase 2, the AI will generate real epics, user stories, and story points

agileMethodology.antiHallucination: ✅ Engine transparency: All displayed values (sprints, duration, cost) are deterministically calculated by PilotAI using the formulas described above — they are not generated by free inference from the language model. Every number has a traceable formula.
